# 受力移动操作训练中应如何生成末端扰动？

> **当前答案：** 在 FALCON 的 G1/T1 设置中，按末端 Jacobian、重力力矩和关节力矩余量限制三维扰动，并逐步扩大其尺度，配合共享观测的上下身双策略，可比无力矩感知扰动、上身 PD/IK 和同栈单体全身 RL 获得更低受力跟踪误差；该静态近似不等于实机接触或热安全保证。

- Unitree G1
- Booster T1

## 适用模拟器

- Isaac Gym

## 控制器与方法

- FALCON dual-agent PPO

## 适用环境

- 252 ACCAD targets under three force levels
- reported G1/T1 forceful tasks

## 成立假设

- End-effector Jacobians and joint torque limits are available in simulation.
- Lower-body locomotion and upper-body joint tracking form separable objectives with shared proprioception.

## 排查与验证

- 先核对适用机器人、模拟器、控制器、环境和成立假设，再沿下方证据定位复核原始实验或实现。

## 结果

- 在 FALCON 的 G1/T1 设置中，按末端 Jacobian、重力力矩和关节力矩余量限制三维扰动，并逐步扩大其尺度，配合共享观测的上下身双策略，可比无力矩感知扰动、上身 PD/IK 和同栈单体全身 RL 获得更低受力跟踪误差；该静态近似不等于实机接触或热安全保证。

## 限制

- End-effector Jacobians and joint torque limits are available in simulation.
- Lower-body locomotion and upper-body joint tracking form separable objectives with shared proprioception.

## 安全提示

- **仿真验证：** 是
- **指令限制：** Before hardware use, derive robot- and firmware-specific position, velocity, torque and contact-force limits; paper training clips are not deployment limits.
- **急停：** Before force interaction, test an independent human-accessible emergency stop and verify stopping at the selected low-energy envelope.
- **保护措施：** Use a cleared exclusion zone, secured load, compatible fall protection, thermal/current monitoring, and a human safety operator.
- **机器人特定警告：** Evidence covers only the reported Unitree G1 and Booster T1 configurations; actuator, wrist, hand and SDK differences require a new review.
- **分阶段部署：** Proceed from fixed-seed simulation to cross-simulator replay, supported no-contact motion, low-force single-axis contact, then bounded multi-axis tasks with logged abort criteria.

- [FALCON: Learning Force-Adaptive Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06776v2>) — `support/primary`；Equations 3-5, Tables 1-4, Figures 2-5；Defines force feasibility and compares dual-agent, monolithic, IK/PD and curriculum variants.
